rationale: MBDP plus per-bank careers/news watchlist is the authoritative origin layer for MK bank procurement-adjacent notices.
LinkedIn bank/vendor pages give earliest programme signals but require login and are ToS-restricted for automated collection.
MK banking association announcements predict sector-wide, near-simultaneous bank procurement.
National clearing house / payment-system operator publishing infrastructure and vendor-partner news — core payments actor.
Single MIA article on one conference; useful as evidence, and URL did not verify — recheck liveness.
One-off media piece on MicroBalkans 2026; keep as evidence, monitor the organiser rather than emagazin.
E-commerce association site publishes sponsor tiers and payment-licensing news — recurring PSP/acquirer signal.
MASIT conference + member directory is the supply-side actor map; mine once, revisit annually.
Chamber IT association member list and event calendar — second independent actor map, mine once.
Low-credibility community forum but a live lead generator on MK fintech/payments migrations; verify elsewhere.
Central bank site (MIPS modernisation, calls, notices) is the strongest upstream predictor of MK bank procurement; failed URL is soft signal only.
Single conference page under mse.mk; monitor the exchange's news root instead.
One vendor press release evidencing Entrust/BCS win at Komercijalna; wire itself is not an MK-scoped source.
Aggregator bank directory useful once as seed list; NBRM remains the authoritative register.
NLB d.d. public-calls page is the group-level tender feed that cascades to NLB Banka Skopje.
Subsidiary profile page within nlbgroup.com; covered by monitoring the group site/reports.
Erste Group Procurement publishes the supplier gatekeeping rules governing vendors to Sparkasse Skopje.
Verbund partner listing is static context on the Sparkasse parent estate; low standalone signal rate.
Halkbank TR announcements feed is live but dominated by foreclosure auctions; low signal density for IT/payments.
EKAP tender search is a legitimate procurement portal but MK relevance depends on unverified Halkbank contracting-entity publishing; URL unverified.
Single Georgian sibling tender notice; useful as a spec template exemplar, monitor the group tender index instead.
Opentender.eu archive would solve the expired-MK-notice problem, but URL failed and MK dataset freshness needs confirming.
Wayback CDX API over e-nabavki.gov.mk recovers removed/expired MK tender notices — public API, directly on-scope.
